title: An event camera position: res/field/cameras/event/<n>.json
description: File n of ARCID_SCRCMD_CAMERA (a/1/6/1), an EvCameraMoveData (scrcmd_camera.c): a position that the script command Scrcmd_Camera_EvCameraMoveToCommon names by its number and moves the event camera to (FieldCameraAnm_SetAnimation). tools/data/event_camera_data.py packs them in order.

pitch.description: The camera's pitch, in 65536ths of a turn

yaw.description: The camera's yaw, in 65536ths of a turn

distance.description: The camera's distance from its target, in 4096ths of a unit

target.description: The point the camera looks at, in 4096ths of a unit

animate.description: What the move animates (FieldEvCameraAnimationFlags): the camera's extra translation, pitch, yaw, distance, field of view and target; the rest stays
